messages:
Alice (People Ops): Hey team — finalizing the OKR + self-review templates we'll roll out for the upcoming performance cycle. Dropping a short draft below, would love quick feedback by EOD tomorrow. :raised_hands:

Alice (People Ops): Draft self-review template (please keep each section short):
```
1) Role & focus (1 sentence)
2) Top contributions this cycle (3 bullets, 1-2 lines each)
3) Measurable impact (metrics or examples)
4) Areas I want to improve (2 bullets)
5) Career goals & support needed (1-2 bullets)
6) Feedback for manager / team (optional, 1-2 bullets)
```

Alice (People Ops): Manager guidance checklist (for each direct report):
```
- Overall rating suggestion: Exceeds / Meets / Below
- 2-3 evidence bullets tied to role expectations
- Career development plan: 3 concrete actions (owner + timeline)
- Calibration notes: any context to share during calibration
```

Alice (People Ops): Quick Qs: should we enforce char limits (e.g. 500 chars for "Measurable impact")? And do we want an explicit "peer feedback requested" flag?

Ben (Eng Manager): Love the short form. 500 chars for impact feels OK. Keep peer-feedback optional — some ICs won't be ready. :+1:

Carla (IC): Agree on optional peer feedback. One request: add a line under contributions for "blocked by / needs from org" — helps managers unblock.

Dave (Manager): +1 on blocked-by. For managers, can we add a quick "confidence" checkbox for the rating (low/medium/high) so calibration hears uncertainty?

Alice (People Ops): Good ideas — adding blocked-by and confidence flag. Updated snippet: 
```
3.5) Blockers / org support needed (1 bullet)
Manager: confidence in rating: low / medium / high
```

Ben (Eng Manager): Also: example phrasing for evidence would help newer managers. Maybe we include 2 templated examples in the guide.

Alice (People Ops): Will add two short examples (one IC, one manager).

hr-bot: Reminder: Performance cycle opens 2024-04-01. Self-reviews due by 2024-04-15. Managers must submit calibration notes by 2024-04-22. See <https://intra.redwood/people/perf-cycle-2024>.

Carla (IC): Thanks — will do. Small question: can I save a draft in the console and revisit?

Alice (People Ops): Yes — drafts autosave in the console. I'll include that in the rollout note.

Ben (Eng Manager): Timeline makes sense. If no objections, i'll test the template with my team this week and share an example.

Alice (People Ops): Perfect — please ping me with examples. I'll incorporate and publish the final template + manager guide on Monday. :sparkles:
